notes: S1-FIX5 X1/§12.2 check 1c: an unregistered unsigned attribute carries one value encoded 5f 81 80 00 01 01: [APPLICATION 16384] in its minimal high-tag-number form. X.690 §8.1.2.4 only forbids 0x80 as the first subsequent octet; the inner 0x80 and 0x00 groups are part of the minimal base-128 form. The receipt is fully re-signed with the test TSA key (messageDigest recomputed, signature over the signed attributes renewed), so it is strict DER, the CMS signature verifies and the container is valid.
